what: The GPU code of study 5's order repeat on Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct (docs/study5-llama-registration.md): the identity of its GPU paths at the commit named.
engineering_check: The Llama Pod reruns pod 2's Qwen order control of seed 50000 at η_l under this code before anything else and compares it under extension 2's numerical equivalence; a failure stops the Pod. On Llama itself the stage-0 checks run before any training run (scripts/study5_llama_campaigns.py, checks plan): a failed path-field check stops, and their teacher-gap measurement sets the runs' thresholds. The paths changed since the AdamW repeat's record add Llama's model config (its pad token and fixed chat date, models.pin_tokenizer, which leaves a config without them unchanged), its experiment configs and its seeds, orders and rate rule, and list its driver and analysis outside the GPU code. A later GPU change needs a new check and a new record.
